117976.name: Chabad House of Buffalo
117976.note: Jewish Buffalo History: 'Chabad House of Buffalo began as an outreach program to college age students at the University at Buffalo campuses and Buffalo State College in the early 1970s'; 'In 1971 Rabbi Noson Gurary and his wife Miriam established the Chabad House at 3292 Main Street, after running small amounts of programming from their apartment on Amherst Manor Drive.' CrownHeights.info, 2 Oct 2025: 'Rabbi Noson Gurary established the Chabad House of Buffalo in 1971'.

159422.name: Rohr Chabad House - Center for Jewish Life
159422.note: Chabad.org, 15 Sept 2013 (read through Firecrawl): 'It was 1981 when Rabbi Nechemia and Masha Vogel first established Chabad at the University of Rochester, opening the doors of their small home to Jewish college students'; Rabbi Asher Yaras: 'We arrived here in the summer of 2004, when my in-laws shifted their focus to Rochester-wide Chabad activities.' CrownHeights.info, 27 Dec 2022: the Vogels 'moved to Rochester in 1981'.

117699.name: The Rohr Chabad Center for Jewish Student Life at Binghamton University
117699.note: CrownHeights.info, 28 Oct 2010: a dinner 'celebrating 25 years since Rabbi Aaron and Rivkah Slonim opened Chabad-Lubavitch of Binghamton'; 'When Rabbi Aaron and Rivkah Slonim first arrived to the school in 1985'. CrownHeights.info, 9 Sept 2008: 'a center that began with the arrival of Aaron and Rivkah Slonim in 1985.'

118464.name: Chabad of Chautauqua
118464.note: Lubavitch.com, 23 Aug 2002: 'The Wilenkins arrived in Chautauqua for the summer of 2001, to found "The Jewish Discussion Group," offering classes on a wide range of Jewish subjects and inviting the community for Shabbat services and meals.' A summer programme at the Chautauqua Institution.

2664693.name: Chabad of Clinton
2664693.note: CrownHeights.info, 6 Oct 2026: 'Rabbi Didy and Devorah Waks established Chabad of Clinton in 2014, initially hosting students in their home' (Hamilton College). Its chabad.org listing went up 21 Aug 2014.

6624274.name: Chabad Niagara Falls USA
6624274.note: Lubavitch.com on CrownHeights.info, 9 May 2025: Rabbi Yehuda and Yehudis Lorber, 'who founded Chabad of Niagara Falls, U.S.A', lived in Buffalo and 'made frequent visits to the Falls on behalf of Chabad of Buffalo before formally launching the center in 2024.' Its chabad.org listing went up 6 Nov 2024.
